Three bypass lines are available: Line A empties a full tank in $5$ hours, Line B empties a full tank in $9$ hours, and Line C empties a full tank in $18$ hours. problems.prompt: During maintenance on a municipal water tower, a main drain valve that empties a full tower in $12$ hours and an auxiliary bleed line that empties a full tower in $36$ hours both remain open. Three backup inflow pumps are available to refill the empty tower while both drain lines stay open: Pump A fills an empty tower alone in $10$ hours, Pump B fills it alone in $8$ hours, and Pump C fills it alone in $6$ hours. Maintenance must finish within a $20$-hour window. Using the only pump that can fill the tower within this window while both drain lines remain open, how many hours does it take to fill the tower?

problems.inputHint: Enter a whole number in hours
problems.checkpointHint: Combine the two open drain rates first, then test each pump's net rate against both positive accumulation and the maintenance time limit before inverting the surviving rate.
